neighbours.label: In Python code, the 'st'/'ST' piece that opens a file-status field read from a stat result: os.stat(...).st_size / .st_mtime / .st_mode / .st_ino (also via Path(...).stat()) and stat.ST_MODE / stat.ST_SIZE, strongest when chained right after .stat(); quiet for os.path.getsize / getmtime, the stat.S_ISDIR / S_IRUSR permission helpers, other code constants like tm_year or AF_INET, and the words 'stat' or 'status' in prose.
quiet: The orchestra played Tchaikovsky until late in the evening.
Check the file status before uploading the report.
The stat on page three shows a rise in sales.

predictions: expect >=6/8 fire (chained .stat().st_x strongest), the QtGui.QFont leak near miss may reach ~0.4, other near misses quiet
short: the st_ / ST_ prefix of Python stat-result fields
notes: Step-in from bonsai1/L29/N3065+ (only two readers found; L33/N1814+ already mapped). Drop is tiny (0.03) and the label has nothing to do with the feeder's 'since X, you can Y' meaning. Feeders-first: top feeders L31/N6062- (file-system/stat code: S_IS, ).st) and L26/N8691- (icon/image paths) are code cells. Also fires more weakly on Qt's QtGui.Q class prefix (0.3-0.4, patchy) and on odd name pieces (Rud-yard Kipling, Jose-y Wales) but not on most split names (Schwarzenegger, Tchaikovsky). + pole is dense (30% of tokens).
